units.source_text: 古歌：“君心思我否，但看晴与雨。

en.t: An old poem says, "Does your heart think of me? Just look at the clear sky and the rain.

units.source_text: 欲问知心雨，雨降竟如注。”

en.t: When I try to ask the rain that knows my heart, the rain falls at last as if poured down."
This poem appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 她引用此歌，是怨恨薰君不思念她。

en.t: She quoted this poem because she resented Lord Kaoru for not thinking of her.
